Blackberry Jam Monster eJuice Nicotine Free brings Monster Labs's blackberry jam monster free e-liquid to adult vapers who want a dependable everyday flavor. It is made for refillable pod systems and tanks, so you keep the freedom to pair it with the device you already own.

Blackberry Jam Monster eJuice Nicotine Free is listed at $13.99 in our Vape Juice range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Vape Juice](/shop/vape-juice/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Blackberry Jam Monster Free points to a rounded berry profile that leans fruity without feeling heavy, with a bold, fizzy energy-drink style flavor with a sweet, tangy profile. Taste is subjective, and the same flavor can read sweeter or sharper depending on the device and your own palate, so use this as a starting point.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Monster Labs
- **Category:** Vape Juice
- **Flavor:** Blackberry Jam Monster Free
- **Nicotine strength:** 50mg (5%)
- **Price:** $13.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Clearly labelled strength:** the nicotine strength is shown on the label and on this page, making it easier to compare against what you used before.
- **Consistent batches:** stocked from the manufacturer's regular production, so repeat orders taste like the last one.
- **Flavor-forward recipe:** keeps the taste clear and recognizable instead of muddy, which matters most when you vape the same flavor all day.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
Blackberry Jam Monster eJuice Nicotine Free suits adult vapers with a refillable pod or tank who want to stay with a flavor they enjoy, and those comparing strengths and bottle sizes before they restock.

## Using and caring for it
Check that your device supports the type of e-liquid you buy: nicotine-salt liquids suit low-power pod systems, while freebase liquids are usually chosen for sub-ohm tanks and higher wattage. Fill slowly, wipe the tip clean, let a fresh coil soak for a few minutes before the first puff, and keep the bottle upright with the cap closed between uses. Store it away from heat and direct sunlight, and keep it away from children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
Checkout accepts Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, crypto and gift cards. Choosing crypto or a gift card takes 10% off your total, and orders of $200 or more after that discount ship free. A flat $15 fee applies to smaller orders, and the minimum order is $100.

Your parcel leaves our Phoenix Stock Warehouse within 24 to 72 business hours and ships with a tracking number. Adult signature (21+) is required on delivery, as federal PACT Act rules require for vapor products, so please plan to be available or choose an address where an adult can sign.

## Returns and support
If something is wrong with your order, contact us within 30 days and we will help. Unopened items in original packaging can be returned or exchanged, a 15% restocking fee applies to refunds, and refunds go back through the payment method you originally used. Opened or used e-liquid and devices cannot be returned. Our refund policy has the full details. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
